main_body: Magenta vending machine body with a glass display window, side buttons and a dispensing flap, topped by a grey-blue header panel.
top_band: Grey-blue band at rows 1-5 with a dark horizontal slot in its middle, then a pink line at rows 6-7. The slot makes it read as a vertical sign or header panel, not a horizontal surface.
evidence: The column reads grey-blue band, pink line, dark shadow, then a flat magenta face with the window, buttons and flap. The grey-blue band has a dark slot and a bevel, so it looks like a face-on sign panel, not a foreshortened top. The pink line and dark row are a thin edge-and-eave stack under a header, so this is a front elevation with a hat. The window is inset with a dark border, but that does not create a visible top surface on the main body.

style.evidence: The magenta body has about 3-4 tones and large flat fills, especially the lower panel and the side strips. Outlines are dark purple, tinted but fairly uniform. The window shelves have some colour variety. There is no grain or speckle, and the tiles carry far fewer colours than the stall and well references, so it looks thinner and flatter.
